name: A Paused campaign must not resume while its phone numbers are Archived
fullName: deploy/bugreplicator.spec.ts › Bug Replicator › A Paused campaign must not resume while its phone numbers are Archived
statusMessage:
Error: BUG: campaign "Demo_Camp_1791439774016" was Paused and every phone number it calls on (+917971413658, +917965853872) was Archived. Resuming should have been refused and the campaign should have stayed Paused -- the same numbers cannot even be archived while the campaign is Active, where the app rejects it outright. Instead the resume was accepted and the campaign moved to "Scheduled", leaving a live campaign dialling Archived numbers.

expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality

Received: "Scheduled"
